home.title: The funny things your friends say, kept somewhere safe.
home.intro: Make a group, share the link, and let everyone add the quotes worth remembering. No accounts needed - everything lives in this browser unless you choose to sync it.
home.empty: You haven't joined any groups on this device yet. Create one, or join an existing group with a link.
home.openGroupPlaceholder: Leave blank for an open group
home.linkPlaceholder: Paste the link a friend sent you
home.nameRequired: Give your group a name first.
home.linkRequired: Paste the group link or ID you were given.
home.notFound: That group doesn't exist. Check the link.
account.title: Sync your groups across devices
account.intro: By default your groups only live in this browser. Create a small password-protected account to back up and sync the list of groups you belong to - the quotes themselves always stay on the server, this just syncs which groups this device knows about.
group.checkLink: Double check the link, or head back home.
group.leaveConfirm: Remove "{name}" from this device? The group and its quotes stay online.
group.quotePlaceholder: I'm not saying it was aliens, but it was aliens.
group.personPlaceholder: Start typing a name, or leave empty for someone...
group.dateTimeInvalid: Choose a valid date and time.
group.noQuotes: No quotes yet. Be the first to add one above.
